text: I have written my own D-14 to D-1 plan with real dates, mock cases and weak spots filled in.
I know a weak spot means under 70% on a topic over my last two quiz attempts (or a stale section), and I retake quizzes the next day rather than immediately.
I review due flashcards every day and stop adding new cards about eight days before the interview.
I have redone my failed simulator challenges, predicting the mechanism out loud before running each one.
I can read my dashboard interview trend critically: my own self-score, inflated by repeats of the same case.
I have read the interview-day checklist, prepared my setup, and planned a 20–30 minute warm-up.
